name: Advanced Mini Cart – Floating AJAX Cart & Sidebar
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Advanced Mini Cart – Floating AJAX Cart & Sidebar is a lightweight plugin that adds a floating, customizable mini cart icon to your store — complete with real-time AJAX updates, sidebar display option, custom icon upload, and responsive design.

No coding needed. Just install, activate, and customize the cart’s appearance and behavior via the user-friendly admin panel.

🎯 Key Features

  • Enable or disable floating mini cart icon
  • Position control – bottom-left or bottom-right of the screen
  • Mini Cart Display Mode – choose between:
    • Show Cart on Hover
    • Show Cart as Sidebar (on click)
  • Custom icon support – upload your own cart image or use defaults
  • Sticky cart visibility – stays visible as users scroll
  • AJAX-powered updates – real-time add/remove/modify without reload
  • Fully responsive – works on all devices
  • Lightweight and optimized – no extra bloat

🎨 Design Customization

Easily match the mini cart to your site’s branding with built-in color pickers:

  • Mini cart background and text colors
  • Header background and text colors
  • Subtotal area styles
  • Cart and checkout button colors

🚀 Why Use Mini Cart?

Provide your customers with a fast, seamless cart experience. Keep the cart always accessible, display it as a floating icon or a full sidebar, and allow instant updates without leaving the page.

sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Advanced Mini Cart – Floating AJAX Cart & Sidebar
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Mini Cart Settings to configure options
sections.faq:
❓ Does this plugin support AJAX?

Yes, it uses AJAX for real-time add/remove/update actions.

❓ What is the “Mini Cart Display Mode”?

You can choose to show the cart when hovering over the icon or display it as a sidebar on click.

❓ Can I use a custom icon?

Yes, you can upload your own cart icon or choose from the built-in options.

❓ Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes, the mini cart is fully responsive and adapts to all screen sizes.

❓ Does it work with any WooCommerce theme?

It works with all standard WooCommerce-compatible themes. For custom themes, minor CSS tweaks might be needed.

❓ Can I customize colors without coding?

Absolutely. All major elements have color pickers in the settings panel.
